_comment: Hand-authored place-type templates for /simulate's routine/arc mechanism. A context is authored once here, not per character - texture and 'provides' are shared by every routine tagged with this context. This is a deliberately minimal starting set (5 contexts) shipped with the repo, not fixed in stone - authors can add more by hand as new routines need a place-type not covered here, same discipline as everything else authored rather than generated in this system. `provides` is currently just a semantic tag used for arc-need matching (check_needs_provides.py); its vocabulary is deliberately minimal right now (materials, items, transit, nourishment, records, news) since the actual interaction mechanic for `provides` hasn't been built yet and will expand once it is. `grounding_provides` is a separate, unrelated field: it gates which _lore/grounding/mechanics.json entries a character with this routine context knows (scripts/lore/sample_grounding.py) - not something touched in this cleanup pass, kept as-is on the 3 contexts that already had a mapping. `route` (renamed from `transit` in this cleanup) is the one context not anchored to a single place - its own `location` should name a route between two points, not a point.

market.texture: Buying and selling, price disputes, scarcity, trust in a trading partner or supplier, goods that come and go with the season or the ships.

temple.texture: Rites, quiet devotion, disputes over doctrine or upkeep, the material cost of keeping a sacred place running, pilgrims and mourners passing through.

commons.texture: Foot traffic and passing carts, vendors calling from doorways, neighbors crossing paths without meaning to, the ordinary publicness of a city's shared, unowned space.

home.texture: Rest, family, the private counterpart to every public context — meals shared or eaten alone, the upkeep of a life outside work and trade, the people who know you before any reputation does.

route.texture: Between places, not at one — the road, the crossing, the stretch of a journey with nowhere yet arrived. Distance measured in progress rather than a fixed point; provisional company, whoever else is making the same crossing; the open question of whether this leg is a going or a coming. A routine tagged with this context is deliberately not anchored to one place the way every other context is — its own `location` should name the route, not a single point.
